label: ProLiant DL380 Gen11 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server with no embedded LOM: primary networking is a choice of OCP 3.0 or stand-up card, modelled here as a 2-port 10/25GbE adapter. The 1GbE iLO 6 management port is dedicated and separate.
notes: IMPORTANT: no onboard data NICs - eth0/eth1 are the 2x 10/25GbE SFP28 OCP 3.0 adapter. OCP 3.0 is the primary networking bay; additional NICs go in PCIe 5.0 slots. iLO 6 on its own 1GbE port, plus a front iLO service USB port (not modelled).
